ModMetaData.name: Trade Caravan Lord Integrity Fix 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Prevents trade caravan incidents from reusing pawns that already belong to another Lord. A TradeWithColony Lord is created only when it contains a live, spawned trader. Existing trader-less trade Lords are removed or converted to a normal exit Lord before they can generate a repeating exception storm.
